$comment: The merge gate (scripts/checks/README.md, Merge gate). mode: gate (a same-repo PR runs only the selected checks, and the Merge gate job is the verdict) or shadow (the full run gates; the gated verdict is published beside it). factory: the pinned selector release (the factory commit and the SHA-256 of factory-linux-arm64.tar.gz); null until the first release. acceptAgentResults: a pass that an agent or a person stored satisfies the gate. acceptPrResults: a pass of an earlier CI run of the same PR (the PR store) satisfies the gate.
